plans.plan:
Monday
Warmup: 5 mins (Dynamic stretching: leg swings, world’s greatest stretch, bodyweight squats).
Main lifts: Back Squat (3 x 6-8, rest 2m), Romanian Deadlift (3 x 8-10, rest 90s).
Accessories: Walking Lunges (3 x 12/leg, rest 60s), Calf Raises (3 x 15, rest 45s).
Finisher/conditioning: Kettlebell Swings (4 x 20, rest 30s).

Tuesday
Warmup: 5 mins (Arm circles, band pull-aparts, scapular push-ups).
Main lifts: Barbell Bench Press (3 x 6-8, rest 2m), Overhead Press (3 x 8-10, rest 90s).
Accessories: Incline DB Press (3 x 10, rest 60s), Lateral Raises (3 x 15, rest 45s).
Finisher/conditioning: Push-ups (3 x AMRAP, rest 45s).

Wednesday
Warmup: 5 mins (Light walking/mobility flow).
Main lifts: Active Recovery Day.
Accessories: 20-30 minute light incline walk or steady-state cycling.
Finisher/conditioning: 10 mins foam rolling/static stretching.

Thursday
Warmup: 5 mins (Hip circles, glute bridges, bird-dogs).
Main lifts: Conventional Deadlift (3 x 5, rest 2-3m), Leg Press (3 x 10-12, rest 90s).
Accessories: Bulgarian Split Squats (3 x 10/leg, rest 60s), Leg Curls (3 x 12, rest 60s).
Finisher/conditioning: 500m Row sprint x 3 (rest 1m between sprints).

Friday
Warmup: 5 mins (Cat-cow, shoulder dislocations with PVC/band).
Main lifts: Pull-ups or Lat Pulldowns (3 x 8-10, rest 90s), Barbell Rows (3 x 8-10, rest 90s).
Accessories: Face Pulls (3 x 15, rest 45s), DB Bicep Curls (3 x 12, rest 45s).
Finisher/conditioning: Battle Ropes (5 rounds: 30s on / 30s off).

Saturday
Warmup: 5 mins (Full body dynamic movement).
Main lifts: DB Thrusters (4 x 10, rest 60s).
Accessories: Goblet Squats (3 x 12, rest 60s), Plank (3 x 60s, rest 45s).
Finisher/conditioning: 15-minute HIIT circuit (30s Mountain Climbers, 30s Burpees, 30s Air Squats, 30s Rest).

Sunday
Warmup: None.
Main lifts: Full Rest Day.
Accessories: Optional light walking.
Finisher/conditioning: None.

Coach Notes:
- Progressive Overload: To build lean strength, aim to increase the weight or reps slightly every week.
- Tempo: Control the eccentric (lowering) phase of every lift for 2 seconds to maximize muscle tension.
- Hydration & Energy: Drink at least 3 liters of water daily. If energy feels low, ensure you are eating enough protein (approx. 1g per lb of body weight).
- Recovery: Prioritize 7-8 hours of sleep. If you feel overly fatigued, reduce the weight on "Accessories" by 10% for one session.
- Form: Since you are training in a commercial gym, utilize mirrors to check your spine alignment, especially during Deadlifts and Squats.

Monday

Warmup: 5 mins (Bodyweight squats, leg swings, arm circles, cat-cow stretch).
Main Lifts: 
- DB Goblet Squats: 4 sets x 10-12 reps (90s rest)
- DB Romanian Deadlifts: 4 sets x 10-12 reps (90s rest)
Accessories:
- DB Alternating Reverse Lunges: 3 sets x 12 reps per leg (60s rest)
- DB Calf Raises: 3 sets x 15-20 reps (45s rest)
Finisher/Conditioning:
- 3 Rounds: 30s DB Goblet Marches (high knees), 30s Rest.

Tuesday

Warmup: 5 mins (Push-up to down-dog, T-spine rotations, shoulder taps).
Main Lifts:
- DB Floor Press: 4 sets x 10 reps (90s rest)
- DB Single-Arm Rows: 4 sets x 10 reps per side (90s rest)
Accessories:
- DB Seated Overhead Press: 3 sets x 12 reps (60s rest)
- DB Lateral Raises: 3 sets x 15 reps (45s rest)
Finisher/Conditioning:
- Max push-ups in 2 minutes (Rest as needed within the window).

Wednesday

Active Recovery: 20-30 minute light walk, yoga, or mobility flow. Focus on breathing and hip/shoulder opening.

Thursday

Warmup: 5 mins (Glute bridges, bird-dogs, walking lunges).
Main Lifts:
- DB Sumo Squats: 4 sets x 12 reps (90s rest)
- DB Single-Leg Deadlifts: 3 sets x 10 reps per side (90s rest)
Accessories:
- DB Bulgarian Split Squats: 3 sets x 8-10 reps per leg (60s rest)
- DB Weighted Glute Bridges: 3 sets x 15 reps (60s rest)
Finisher/Conditioning:
- 4 Rounds: 30s DB Swings (hinge movement), 30s Rest.

Friday

Warmup: 5 mins (Arm circles, plank-to-pike, shadow boxing).
Main Lifts:
- DB Renegade Rows: 4 sets x 10 reps total (90s rest)
- DB Incline Floor Press (use a pillow/cushion for slight incline): 4 sets x 12 reps (90s rest)
Accessories:
- DB Bicep Curls: 3 sets x 12 reps (45s rest)
- DB Overhead Tricep Extensions: 3 sets x 12 reps (45s rest)
Finisher/Conditioning:
- DB Shadow Boxing (light weights): 3 rounds of 1 minute (45s rest).

Saturday

Warmup: 5 mins (Jumping jacks, mountain climbers, air squats).
Main Lifts (Metabolic Circuit):
- DB Thrusters (Squat to Overhead Press): 4 sets x 12 reps (60s rest)
- DB Alternating Snatches: 4 sets x 10 reps total (60s rest)
Accessories:
- DB Farmer’s Carry: 3 sets x 40 yards or 45 seconds (60s rest)
- DB Suitcase Crunch: 3 sets x 15 reps (45s rest)
Finisher/Conditioning:
- AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible) in 5 minutes: 5 Burpees, 10 Air Squats, 15 Sit-ups.

Sunday

Rest: Complete rest or very light stretching. Prioritize sleep and meal prep for the week ahead.

Coach Notes:
- Progression: Aim to increase your dumbbell weight or add 1-2 reps to each set every week to maintain "Lean Strength" adaptations.
- Mind-Muscle Connection: Since you are training at home, focus on the "tempo." Lower the weights slowly (3 seconds down) to increase time under tension.
- Energy Levels: If you feel sluggish, shorten the rest periods to 30 seconds to keep the heart rate elevated, but never sacrifice form.
- Recovery: Ensure you are consuming adequate protein (0.8g-1g per lb of body weight) to support muscle repair and keep energy levels stable throughout the day.
- Hydration: Drink at least 10-12 ounces of water during the 45-minute session to stay sharp.

Monday
Warmup: 5 mins (Bodyweight squats, arm circles, lunges, cat-cow stretch).
Main lifts:
- DB Goblet Squats: 4 x 10 (Rest: 90s)
- DB Romanian Deadlifts: 4 x 12 (Rest: 90s)
Accessories:
- DB Reverse Lunges: 3 x 10 per leg (Rest: 60s)
- DB Calf Raises: 3 x 15 (Rest: 45s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- 3 rounds: 30s Goblet Squat pulses + 30s rest.

Tuesday
Warmup: 5 mins (Shoulder taps, plank-to-downward dog, dynamic chest stretch).
Main lifts:
- DB Floor Press: 4 x 10 (Rest: 90s)
- DB Single-Arm Row: 4 x 10 per arm (Rest: 60s)
Accessories:
- DB Standing Overhead Press: 3 x 12 (Rest: 60s)
- DB Lateral Raises: 3 x 15 (Rest: 45s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- AMRAP in 5 mins: 10 Push-ups + 10 DB Bicep Curls.

Wednesday
Warmup: 5 mins light walking or jogging in place.
Main lifts:
- Active Recovery: 20-30 mins of mobility work or yoga.
Accessories:
- Plank: 3 x 45 seconds (Rest: 45s)
- Bird-Dogs: 3 x 12 per side (Rest: 30s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- 15-minute brisk walk outdoors for energy.

Thursday
Warmup: 5 mins (Jumping jacks, mountain climbers, hip openers).
Main lifts:
- DB Thrusters: 4 x 10 (Rest: 90s)
- DB Single-Arm Snatch: 4 x 8 per arm (Rest: 60s)
Accessories:
- DB Step-ups: 3 x 10 per leg (Rest: 60s)
- DB Renegade Rows: 3 x 8 per side (Rest: 60s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- Tabata (4 mins): 20s High Knees / 10s Rest.

Friday
Warmup: 5 mins (Scapular slides, arm circles, inchworms).
Main lifts:
- DB Incline Floor Press (shoulders on a cushion/bench if available, otherwise flat): 4 x 12 (Rest: 90s)
- DB Bent Over Rows (Neutral Grip): 4 x 12 (Rest: 90s)
Accessories:
- DB Hammer Curls: 3 x 12 (Rest: 45s)
- DB Overhead Tricep Extension: 3 x 12 (Rest: 45s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- 3 rounds: 45s Shadow Boxing with light DBs (or no weight) + 15s rest.

Saturday
Warmup: 5 mins (Full body dynamic stretching).
Main lifts:
- DB Suitcase Deadlifts: 4 x 12 per side (Rest: 60s)
- DB Weighted Glute Bridges: 4 x 15 (Rest: 60s)
Accessories:
- DB Farmers Walk: 3 x 40 yards/seconds (Rest: 60s)
- DB Shrugs: 3 x 15 (Rest: 45s)
Finisher/conditioning:
- 10 mins: Every Minute on the Minute (EMOM) - 10 DB Swings (using one DB).

Sunday
Warmup: None.
Main lifts: Full Rest Day.
Accessories: Optional light stretching or foam rolling.
Finisher/conditioning: None.

Coach Notes:
- Progressive Overload: To build lean strength, aim to increase the weight of your dumbbells or add 1-2 repetitions to each set every two weeks.
- Energy Management: Focus on "explosive" concentric movements (the lifting phase) and controlled eccentric movements (the lowering phase) to maximize muscle fiber recruitment without draining all your energy.
- Tempo: Use a 2-1-2-1 tempo (2 seconds down, 1 second pause at the bottom, 2 seconds up, 1 second squeeze at the top).
- Recovery: Ensure you are consuming adequate protein (0.7g - 1g per lb of body weight) to support lean tissue growth. Drink at least 3 liters of water daily to maintain energy levels during home sessions.
